svg.aria-label: The network with Paris, then without it
svg.title: The network with Paris, then without it

g.text: One set of coordinates, drawn twice; only the ties differ. Paris holds 762 placed firms, 19.5% of them, and touches 19,507 of the 43,164 drawable ties (45.2%). The second panel is what is left: 23,657 ties, and its shape is a lattice between colonies rather
than a hub. Read it against the coverage bias — a firm with no address is placed at its filing country, which moves ties that may have been Parisian out into the colonies.
